name: fintech-legal-advisor
description: Fintech regulatory issue-spotter for Claude Cowork — KYC/AML, payment licensing, MiCA / crypto, GDPR, customer contracts, marketing claims. A fintech-specific complement to Anthropic's Claude for Legal (whose practice-area plugins cover general commercial / corporate / privacy / IP / litigation, but not fintech regulation). Strongly recommends installing Claude for Legal alongside (Cowork → Customize → Browse plugins → Legal) so the plugin can prefer its MCP connectors: Westlaw / Practical Law / CoCounsel for primary-law verification; Box / iManage / NetDocuments / Docusign as contract sources; Microsoft Word for tracked-change output. Declares regulatory-legal as a soft dependency. One Opus-pinned subagent, one skill, one setup command that wires a Cowork Routine on Drive (or any supported document source) to triage new contracts. Produces issue lists, never verdicts. Every output ends with a non-negotiable take-to-counsel block. Not legal advice.
